author: alucard5
quote: I didn’t live to the expectations. I find the game extremely boring. At least devs should add option for Jason to be in relationship with guys as well, which would make some fresh content for 2026.

author: alucard5
quote: It is a wonderful combo of two great games. I only miss some quality of life improvements such as photo and music galleries, save states, rewind feature (although it is not needed for enjoyment of the games).
game_title: Castlevania Requiem: Symphony of the Night & Rondo of Blood

author: alucard5
quote: It is a fun game, however Nintendo needs to add Donkey Kong island and more Kongs as playable characters. DK and Pauline are the only characters missing skins/outfits.

author: alucard5
quote: I have been enjoying this DLC so much. Not only is the mode very fun to play, but the addition of the beautiful DK island is an amazing gift. I love gathering statues in timed events. Well worth the purchase.
game_title: Donkey Kong Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush

author: alucard5
quote: I found the game boring and too similar to previous installments. I will not be losing my time with games like this one. Retro studios should go back to making Donkey Kong Country games, in which they did really well.

author: alucard5
quote: Donkey Kong is back and better than ever. This was not only my most anticipated game, but it is the best 3D game I have ever played in my life! Controls are so fluid and enjoyable, DK looks awesome and expressive, gathering bananas (Banandium gems), running, jumping, digging through layers feels incredibly satisfying. I loved the story and especially the last section. It’s DK and the journey to the centre of Earth, most incredible experience I have had in gaming. The transformations into different animals is so fun, the music is fantastic. So many DK stuff from the past is back, I couldn’t be happier. The devs really put a lot of love and care into this game.

author: alucard5
quote: Looks nice, but it is not as good as Mario Kart Tour which is really fun due to point system in races as well as fun characters and numerous karts and gliders. I find 8 Deluxe extremely boring in comparison.

author: alucard5
quote: I wanted to enjoy this game, as it is similar to Castlevania Portrait of Ruin which I love. However, the girls are extremely annoying protagonists as they shout and screem in a girly annoying way EACH time you make an attack. No possibility to turn off this “feature” is unacceptable. Devs should go back to Bloodstained franchise where they shine.

author: alucard5
quote: Wonderful game, great story, music, gameplay. A love letter to classic Castlevanias. I wish these developers make sequels for Bloodstained. I have enjoyed this game much more than main Ritual of the night. Zangetsu is the coolest character, I also love Gebel and Robert, while Miriam, Dominique and dog are fairly uninteresting.

author: alucard5
quote: Very slow and buggy, terrible controls and combat. Long loading times between screens/rooms which is unacceptable. I was a backer and this kind of developer makes me decide this was my last kickstarter. They ignore the feedback. Extremely disappointing game and overall experience.

author: alucard5
quote: Metroid Dread looks very poor and is not a very good game. It was too hyped, but did not manage to deliver. I find most areas uninspiring and dreadful (pun intended). It is not worth more than 5 dollars.

author: alucard5
quote: I like Doom a lot, this patched version on Switch works very well. In my opinion the controls are not easy to handle when playing in portable mode. I can only play this docked and survive. I would like cheats to be added to make the game more fun.

author: alucard5
quote: I enjoyed this game, but the performance on Switch is awful, and it has huge input lag that breaks the game for me. Developers should have worked more on this port as Switch is the most popular console for this type of game. Soundtrack is very nice. I would prefer Zangetsu as the main character, Miriam is very boring and bland.

author: alucard5
quote: I don’t like the colors of this game. The gameplay is not very appealing. I am very disappointed, maybe I would give it better score if it was much cheaper. I don’t understand why many were excited about this.

author: alucard5
quote: This is an amazing game, a real throwback to older Castlevania titles (especially CV3) but made in a modern way. I enjoyed the soundtrack a lot, too. I like this game better than the main Bloodstained title.
